parsed.post: The attempt to increase DEPTH to 8 resulted in a slight regression (1.023 vs 1.021). It seems the architecture might be hitting a stability limit or the learning rate is too high for this depth. Reverting to DEPTH=6 and will focus on optimizing the learning rate and batch size next.
parsed.description: Reverting to depth 6 and lowering learning rate to see if better convergence is possible with a more stable training signal.
